name: Mir Madan
seoTitle: Mir Madan: Plassey Artillery Commander under Siraj ud-Daulah
seoDescription: Profile of Mir Madan, Siraj ud-Daulah's artillery commander at Plassey whose fatal battlefield wound affected the Nawab's camp.
contribution: He fought on Siraj's side at Plassey and was fatally wounded in battle.
context: Frontline engagement at the Battle of Plassey, 23 June 1757.
impact: His death weakened the fighting will of Siraj's camp and shifted battlefield momentum.
